Save your processed file

A file is ready only after processing completes and the result panel appears. Downloading an unchanged original from Optimize PDF is expected when structural optimization cannot make it smaller.

Desktop Chrome and Edge

  1. Open the full website in a normal browser tab.
  2. Process the sample document, then click Download.
  3. Check the browser’s Downloads list. Use Save as to choose a folder when that option is available.

Safari and mobile browsers

A browser may open a PDF instead of saving it immediately. Choose Open file, then use the viewer’s download or sharing action. When your browser supports file sharing, Share / Save to Files appears as an additional option.

Embedded previews

Preview frames may restrict downloads or new windows. Use the Open full site link before selecting files. Documents are not transferred from the preview to the new tab; choose them again there. We do not upload the file as a workaround.

ZIP results

Split and PDF-to-JPG outputs can be ZIP archives. Save the archive, then extract it in your device’s file manager. A ZIP is not itself a PDF.

If saving still fails

Keep the tab open, check free disk space and your browser’s blocked-download notice, and try the synthetic sample. A completed download cannot be confirmed by a normal download link, so this site reports a request rather than claiming it was saved. Save as reports success only after the writable file is closed.
